- We prefer parallel routing for legal + finance to save time; let me know if Redwood needs a strict order.

Thanks Ben / Olga — procurement here. A few clarifications from our side before we commit to the 09/24 cutoff:

- Evidence: the PDF looks good; we need the raw SOC2 artifact links (or attestations) and a signed statement about data retention policies. Can Redwood confirm where logs are kept and retention windows?
- PO & billing: we will kick off PO on signature but need billing contact and a sample invoice template.
- Signature flow: Alder prefers parallel routing but requires Legal to have final approval on commercial redlines. Our typical flow is: Legal review (48 hours) -> Finance / Procurement sign -> Exec final. If Redwood supports auto-fallback to the next signer in 48 hours that would help us keep the 09/24 deadline.

Approver timings (Alder PT):
- Procurement review start: 09/16 (AM)
- Legal review start: 09/16 (PM)
- Exec (CFO) final availability: 09/22 — can sign on 09/22 or 09/23.

DocuSign: we'll accept a parallel-enabled envelope but will set Legal as the reviewer with conditional final approval. Please include a DocuSign callback URL so our SSO can capture event timestamps.

Elaine Morris
Sr. Procurement Manager, Alder Systems
procure@aldersys.com
